text_version.title: Shes rab snying po (Heart Sutra)
text_version.summary: The Prajnaparamita Heart Sutra in Tibetan translation from the Kangyur. This is the classic text on emptiness widely studied in Tibetan Buddhism.

person_roles.note: The Heart Sutra attributed to the Buddha in the Tibetan canon.
